name: Seasoned Wolf Kabobs
summary: In Darkshire, Chef Grual prepares his signature dish at the Scarlet Raven Tavern. He asks you to hunt Duskwood wolves for meat while his herbs arrive from Stormwind City.

sections.title: A Dish for Darkshire
sections.body: Darkshire sits isolated among Duskwood's creeping horrors. Trade caravans rarely come, farming has collapsed, and undead lurk nearby, yet the town still needs food. Chef Grual cooks at the Scarlet Raven Tavern, turning dangerous forest wolves into hearty skewers. Local timber and soil cannot support delicate crops, so he depends on spices brought from the capital to make the gamey meat palatable.

sections.title: A Shipment from Stormwind
sections.body: Grual has just received his latest shipment of Stormwind Seasoning Herbs. All he lacks is lean meat from the ferocious wolves stalking Duskwood. The delivery shows how Darkshire remains tied to the wider kingdom: royal military aid has dwindled, while small civic ties and supply lines between city merchants and outer hamlets barely endure.

faq.answer: Chef Grual is the cook stationed at the Scarlet Raven Tavern in Darkshire. He feeds patrons, locals, and Night Watch members with hearty meals made from whatever game can be hunted in the surrounding woods.

faq.q: Where do you get the Stormwind Seasoning Herbs?
faq.answer: You do not need to fetch the Stormwind Seasoning Herbs. Grual has just received his latest shipment; he needs ten Lean Wolf Flanks from you.

faq.q: Where are the wolves for the wolf flanks found?
faq.answer: Wild wolves roam Duskwood's dark forests, especially in the groves and pathways just outside Darkshire. Any local wolf yields the lean meat Grual needs.

faq.q: Why does Darkshire need wolf meat for food?
faq.answer: Darkshire's farmland is ruined and cut off by monsters, making livestock and crops nearly impossible to raise. The locals hunt dangerous wildlife, including the wolves prowling beyond the town's borders.

faq.q: Why can't Grual get herbs locally in Duskwood?
faq.answer: Duskwood's curse has corrupted much of its native plant life, leaving few edible or fragrant cooking herbs. Grual relies on cultivated varieties brought from Stormwind to season his dishes.

faq.q: Does this quest tie into a larger storyline?
faq.answer: This is a standalone local tale, not part of a grand narrative. It shows Darkshire's self-reliant way of life and its tenuous supply link to Stormwind.

angles.text: Grual's recipe shows how wilderness hunters make tough predator meat palatable with refined city spices.
The delivery between Darkshire and Stormwind shows how isolated settlements rely on the capital's markets, even as military garrisons are withheld.
You track down Duskwood's ravenous wolf packs, using your skills to protect the hamlet and keep the tavern's larder stocked.
